D. INTERNAL PLUMBING / DRAINAGE WORK:
a. Drainage/Down Pipes of PVC (Astrol, Supreme) as required.
b. CPVC (Astrol, Supreme) pipes for water supply as specified.
c. Inspection Chambers, Manholes and gully traps etc. as per drawing.
d. Toilets seat fixtures and fittings of Cera,parryware or equivalent, Economical range.
e. W.C.-1, wash basin-1without platform)+tap 1, Diverter or L band.
E. INTERNAL ELECTRICAL WORK
a. Conduct PVC pipe + Band of medium grade of ISI make polycab or cap
b. Junction box, Fan box-Iron, Deep box-C.I.
c. Wire and switches of RR CABLE, POLYCAB, Anchor.
d. Inverter Wiring.
F. FLOORING ( TILE)
Bathroom tiles will be of kajaria (1x1.6’) @55 to60
Floor tiles will be of kajaria (2x4) @60 to 65
Wall tiles in bathroom (height 7’)
Kitchen-
Marble : kitchen marble Rs 80/- to 100/-
Tiles : only 2’ high above the counter.
G. DOOR AND WINDOW
a. Only outer door and windows will be of double patam.
b. All doors will be of ISI marked Flush Doors.
c. Bathroom door will be of waterproof flush door
d. Window frame will be of sagwan wood with 4 mm glass of ASI.
e. Main door with interlock will be provided.
H. PAINTING (Putty)
For interior :- Nerolac, JK, Bajaj wall putty two coat.
Pop design :- in all room.
